Synopsis:
The player peeks into a crevice to see a coin pouch covered in small spiders.

Cluster Contexts:
- CHA_Outpost_Crevice.json: The player is peering into a narrow crevice and sees a coin pouch at the back with a gold coin visible; the bag is swarmed and clutched by many small, chitinous spiders. The spiders are guarding the pouch possessively because a spider egg is nestled inside, so they react protectively rather than tamely. Off-screen companions or prior combat aren’t specified — the moment is a close, quiet inspection with a distinct hissing ambient cue. Attempts to soothe or “attune” to the spiders can make them more nervous, while a sudden reach to snatch the pouch can provoke painful pincers/bites.
